content.title: How to watch Phillies vs. Rangers opening series – Phillies Nation
content.text: Phillies Nation Right fielder Adolis García will debut for the Phillies against his former team. (Photo by Cliff Welch/Icon Sportswire) The Philadelphia Phillies open their 2026 season at home this week against the Texas Rangers. Their pursuit of a fifth consecutive postseason appearance begins with a three-game series at Citizens Bank Park. The series starts Thursday with Opening Day, with first pitch scheduled for 4:15 p.m. After an off day Friday, the two teams will conclude the series with games on Saturday and Sunday. Last season, the Phillies swept the Rangers in a three-game series in Arlington. It was their only meeting that year. They have previously faced each other to open the season in 2014 and 2023, both times in Texas. All three games will be broadcast locally. Here’s when and where you can watch the series on TV: Thursday, March 26, at 4:15 p.m. EDT. NBC Sports Philadelphia. Saturday, March 28, at 4:05 p.m. EDT. NBC Sports Philadelphia+. Sunday, March 29, at 1:35 p.m. EDT. NBC Sports Philadelphia.
